record.question: According to 2011 census, which district of Mizoram has more female population than male population?
record.explanation: Answer A: Aizawl. Aizawl district had more females than males in Census 2011:201,039 females versus 199,270 males. The other printed districts had fewer females than males. The state's original census-based table supplies all four comparisons. Reference: https://des.mizoram.gov.in/uploads/attachments/2022/10/5ddf63c28bb0223c22fe291a605c5668/mizoram-statistical-abstract-2021-22082022-edited.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
